requirements.notes: P23 implements the whole MAC-006 surface: an installer-mediated update that verifies an authenticated manifest (Ed25519 over exact bytes), the Developer ID team, the package signature, digest and length, architecture, minimum macOS, version order, and replay; defers while any task, submission, or runtime is active (a probe failure counts as active); records the intent before any privileged step; takes a verified state snapshot under the maintenance barrier; and hands the package to Apple Installer, quitting only after a confirmed handoff. The bundled engine is never changed independently: a package with a different engine requires an explicit, digest-bound acknowledgement. An older app refuses a newer schema and offers only a verified snapshot it can open, which is then migrated forward. P26 owns the final release matrix; P22 owns the signed artifact for the release trust tier.
